scripts.build: export FUDO_BUILD_ID="${FUDO_BUILD_ID:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || printf 0000000)-$(date +%s)}" && pnpm --filter web build && cf build
scripts.deploy: export FUDO_BUILD_ID="${FUDO_BUILD_ID:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || printf 0000000)-$(date +%s)}" && pnpm --filter web build && cf deploy
